content: **the drains open wider tomorrow.** day gate 2 unlocks three new rats — all three drop into your shop after 06:00 CET. scrap up.

embeds.title: 🛡️ Dire-Rat — 4/5, cost 8
embeds.description: shrugs off 2 damage from every hit it takes — poison still gets through. plant it up front and let the drains waste their swings.

embeds.title: 🩺 MD Rattyfock — 2/6, cost 6
embeds.description: a reskin of Warren-Warden, raised in RatKing's name — season 1's champion, riding the rat that got them there. same battle-start buff to the line behind it, dialed back: fires once now, not every wave like the legend did.

embeds.title: 🧵 Ward-Weaver — 1/3, cost 6
embeds.description:
wards the front of the line each wave — blocks the first hit outright (★2 blocks 2, ★3 blocks 3), then resets clean next wave.

three picks, three jobs: one eats hits, one starts the fight ahead, one no-sells the first blow. day 2, the shop gets honest.

footer.text: we ride at dawn · day gate 2 unlocks 06:00 CET
